body:
Hi @Contact.FirstName@,
This is a reminder that the payment method on your account will expire in @BillingGroup.Month@ @BillingGroup.Year@.
Updating your card now will help prevent any interruption to your music service or a potential reactivation fee.
Please log in here:
https://portal.dynamicmediamusic.com
Username:
@Contact.Email@
If you’re logging in for the first time, here is your temporary password:
@Customer.CustomerID@
Then:
Select Billing Group
Choose @BillingGroup.Name@
Update your card information
If you'd prefer, our customer support team can also assist you by phone.
586-978-4214
Thank you,
Billing Team at Dynamic Media
